```javascript
import orders from './orders.json' with {type:'json'};

const TOOL_DEFINITION = {
  name: 'order_status',
  description: 'Get the current status of an order. Optionally include its chronological history.',
  inputSchema: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      order_id: {
        type: 'string',
        description: 'The unique identifier of the order to look up.'
      },
      include_history: {
        type: 'boolean',
        description: 'Whether to include the chronological history of status changes.',
        default: false
      }
    },
    required: ['order_id'],
    additionalProperties: false
  }
};

export async function listTools() {
  return [TOOL_DEFINITION];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'order_status') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments: expected an object');
  }
  
  const allowed = new Set(['order_id', 'include_history']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowed.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unexpected field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  const { order_id, include_history = false } = args;
  
  if (typeof order_id !== 'string' || order_id.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Invalid order_id: must be a non-empty string');
  }
  
  if (typeof include_history !== 'boolean') {
    throw new Error('Invalid include_history: must be a boolean');
  }
  
  const order = orders[order_id];
  if (!order) {
    throw new Error(`Order not found: ${order_id}`);
  }
  
  const lines = [`Status: ${order.status}`];
  if (include_history) {
    lines.push(`History: ${order.history.join(', ')}`);
  }
  
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: lines.join('\n') }]
  };
}
```
